definitions.explanation: The academic department at a university that teaches engineering disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, civil, and computer engineering.

examples.japanese: {工学部|こうがくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I was accepted into the engineering faculty.

examples.japanese: {工学部|こうがくぶ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{男子|だんし}{学生|がくせい}→男子学生：26705_danshigakusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: The engineering department has many male students.

examples.japanese: {工学部|こうがくぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{卒業生|そつぎょうせい}→卒業生：15284_sotsugyousei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧やIT⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many engineering graduates find employment at manufacturing companies and IT firms.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{工学|こうがく}→工学：04862_kougaku⟧ (engineering) and {学部|がくぶ} (faculty). One of the most popular faculties at Japanese universities, especially for students aiming at careers in manufacturing, technology, and infrastructure — industries central to the Japanese economy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {工学部|こうがくぶ}⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧{工学科|こうがくか}: mechanical engineering department
- {工学部|こうがくぶ}⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧{工学科|こうがくか}: electrical and electronic engineering department
- {工学部|こうがくぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受験|じゅけん}→受験：04272_juken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take the engineering faculty entrance exam
